description: Use this when you need to remove a feature line from a script. Remove a single line from a kernelCAD script identified by a substring match. Returns the modified code plus diagnostics from re-evaluating. Refuses to remove the line containing the return statement. Side-effect-free.

match.description: A substring that uniquely identifies the line to remove (e.g. `const hole = cylinder(5,`).

name: remove_feature

binding_name.description: JS const name bound to the new construct (when one was created).

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics from re-evaluating the modified source.

error.description: Failure message (present when ok is false).

new_code.description: Modified .kcad.ts source (present on success). Caller persists it.

ok.description: Whether the edit applied and re-evaluated cleanly.

title: Remove Feature
